ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field across both lobes; distinct, high-contrast white circular spots (approx. 2-5 pixels) scattered across the interior, with a specific vertical clustering along the central axis leading to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with low-to-medium pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing boundary; distal tips show high-amplitude irregular jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to distal points; trailing edges exhibit a slight concave sweep from the median notch before transitioning to a jagged distal terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white and brownish-red pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered individual white circular points on the dark field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear marks visible on the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular light-colored growths and tissue disruption at both fluke tips, characteristic of persistent biofouling or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical linear alignment of approximately five high-contrast white spots centered on the peduncle transition to the fluke notch.
